title: lmdb: Result<_, String> prevents callers handling MapFull/ReadersFull
description: All public methods in crates/lmdb/src/lib.rs return Result<_, String>. LMDB returns distinct error codes for MDB_MAP_FULL (map size exhausted — needs resize or rejection) and MDB_READERS_FULL (reader lock table full — needs backoff/retry). By erasing these to String, callers cannot programmatically detect and handle them differently. In a production server, MDB_MAP_FULL from put() silently becomes a spurious write failure; MDB_READERS_FULL from get() cannot be distinguished from a corrupt key. Fix: define a LmdbError enum with at least MapFull, ReadersFull, and Other(String) variants, and return Result<_, LmdbError>.
